main.*:
{{Documentation subpage}} {{Lua|icononly=on |Module:Aligned table}} The purpose is of this template is for generating simple tables in locations where [[Help:Table|standard table markup]] is either not possible, without significant use of the {{tld|!}} magic word (e.g., with a {{tl|sidebar}} template), or cumbersome (due to the repetitive use of specification of the same style statement in each row). This template should not be used to replace [[Help:Table|standard table markup]] in articles. This template is meant to be complimentary to {{tl|infobox}} or {{tl|sidebar}}, and not a replacement for {{tl|infobox}} or {{tl|sidebar}}. A simpler method to include a table in a template that does not directly support table markup is to create the table in a sub-template using standard markup and transclude it. == Full syntax == For parameter explanations, see table below. 
{{Aligned table
| cols =
| fullwidth =
| class =
| style =
| colwidth =
| leftright =
| colstyle =
| rowstyle =


| colCwidth =
| colCclass =
| colCalign =
| colCstyle =
| colCnowrap =


| rowRclass =
| rowRstyle =
| rowRheader =


| classR.C =
| styleR.C =

| (cell 1,1) | (cell 1,2) | ... | ...
| (cell 2,1) | (cell 2,2) | ... | ...
}}
== Parameters == {{Aligned table |cols=4 |class=wikitable |style=line-height:1.35em; |colstyle=padding-right:1.0em; |col2width=40.0em |col4style=padding-left:1.0em;text-align:center; |row1header=on | Parameter | Description | Examples | Default | cols | Number of columns in the table. | |cols=4 | 2 | fullwidth | {{nowrap|Set to anything ("on", "true", "yes", etc) to ensure table spans entire width available.}}
(Effect is to remove border-spacing and add width:100% to the table's styling.) | |fullwidth=on | ''not set'' | class | CSS/[[HTML attribute|HTML class]]/es applied to the table. | |class=wikitable   |class=infobox
|class=sortable nowrap   |class=sidebar | ''none'' | style | [[CSS styling]] applied to the table. | {{nowrap| |style=width:80%;background:transparent; }} | ''none'' | colwidth | Width of each column (or include "width:...;" in colstyle). | |colwidth=6.0em   |colwidth=25% | ''not set'' | colstyle | CSS styling applied to each column. | |colstyle=background:transparent; | " | rowstyle | CSS styling applied to each row. | |rowstyle=text-align:center; | " | leftright | Set to anything ("on", "true", "yes", etc) in place of |col1align=left and |col2align=right | |leftright=on | ''not set'' | col{{var|C}}width | Width of column number {{var|C}} (or include "width:...;" in col{{var|C}}style). | |col2width=9.0em   |col3width=35% | ''none set'' | col{{var|C}}class | Class/es applied to column number {{var|C}}. | |col1class=navbox-group | " | col{{var|C}}align | Alignment (left{{\}}right{{\}}center) for column {{var|C}}'s cell contents (or include "text-align:...;" in col{{var|C}}style). | |col4align=right | ''none set'' | col{{var|C}}nowrap | Set to anything ("on", "true", "yes", etc) to add "white-space:nowrap;" to column {{var|C}}'s cell styling (i.e. to prevent lines within its cells from wrapping; or include "nowrap" in col{{var|C}}class or "white-space:nowrap;" in col{{var|C}}style). | |col5nowrap=on | " | col{{var|C}}style | CSS styling applied to column number {{var|C}}. | |col4style=font-style:italic; | " | col{{var|C}}header | Set to any value (e.g. Y) to change col's cells from data cells to table headers (headings). | |col1header=on | ''not set'' | row{{var|R}}class | Class/es applied to row number {{var|R}}. | |row10class=navbox-abovebelow | ''none set'' | row{{var|R}}style | CSS styling applied to row number {{var|R}}. | |row2style=font-weight:bold; | " | row{{var|R}}header | Set to any value (e.g. Y) to change row's cells from data cells to table headers (headings). | |row1header=on | ''not set'' | class{{var|R}}.{{var|C}} | Class/es applied to cell in row {{var|R}}, column {{var|C}}. Overrides any other class attributions (row{{var|R}}class, col{{var|C}}class). | |class1.2=adr | ''none set'' | style{{var|R}}.{{var|C}} | CSS styling applied to cell in row {{var|R}}, column {{var|C}}. Overrides any more general styling (leftright, col{{var|C}}align, row{{var|R}}style, etc). | |style5.3=text-align:right; | " | {{sans-serif|''Unnamed parameters''}} | Each unnamed parameter is taken to be the next cell in the table, starting at the table's top left corner and working left to right from top to bottom. | {{!}} Azerbaijan {{!}} Malta {{!}} Zaire | empty }} == Examples == 
{{Aligned table
|cols=3 |class=wikitable
| A | 1 | a
| B | 2 | b
}}
{{Aligned table |cols=3 |class=wikitable | A | 1 | a | B | 2 | b }} 
{{Aligned table
|cols=4 |class=wikitable
|col1align=center |col2align=center
|col3align=right  |col4align=right
| AAA | aa    | 123  | 12345
| B   | bbbbb | 1234 | 2
}}
{{Aligned table |cols=4 |class=wikitable |col1align=center |col2align=center |col3align=right |col4align=right | AAA | aa | 123 | 12345 | B | bbbbb | 1234 | 2 }} 
{{Aligned table
|class=wikitable |style=width:20em;
|col1align=center |col2align=right
| AAA | 123
| B   | 2
}}
{{Aligned table |class=wikitable |style=width:20em; |col1align=center |col2align=right | AAA | 123 | B | 2 }} 
{{Aligned table
|cols=3 |class=wikitable sortable
|row1header=y
| U | # | l
| A | 1 | a
| B | 2 | b
}}
{{Aligned table |cols=3 |class=wikitable sortable |row1header=y | U | # | l | A | 1 | a | B | 2 | b }} {{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|sandbox | | [[Category:Table and column templates]] }}
